priorityList: Cast Deep Breath once the enemies are grouped up.
Cast Eternity Surge at either rank 1 or matching the amount of targets (Rank 1/2/3 hits 2/4/6 targets with Eternity's Span).
Cast Fire Breath at rank 1 or with Tip the Scales.
Cast Disintegrate after casting Empower spells to trigger Mass Disintegrate; cast on different targets to spread the Bombardments debuff.
Cast Pyre after channeling Mass Disintegrate when fighting 4 or more enemies.
Cast Azure Strike as a filler to generate Essence Burst procs for Pyre.
Cast Living Flame with Burnout procs when Leaping Flames is active to maximize Essence Burst stacks.
Cast Deep Breath on cooldown to apply the Melt Armor debuff and trigger Bombardments.
Cast Fire Breath at Rank 1 to apply the damage-over-time effect to all targets.
Cast Eternity Surge at the maximum rank allowed by the target count to trigger Bombardments.
Spend Essence on Pyre for primary area-of-effect damage when 3 or more targets are present.
Cast Disintegrate if the Mass Disintegrate proc is active to hit multiple targets.
Use Azure Strike as your primary filler to generate Essence and trigger Volatility procs.
